items.name: Shea Butter
items.role: Rich in Vitamins A and E

items.name: Organic Castor Oil
items.role: Contains Ricinoleic Acid: This unique fatty acid is responsible for the vast majority of castor oil's anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and deep-moisturizing properties. Vitamin E: It is rich in tocopherols (part of the Vitamin E family), which act as natural antioxidants. This helps protect your skin and hair from oxidative stress and free radical damage. Omega Fatty Acids: Contains beneficial amounts of Omega-6 and Omega-9 fatty acids, which help nourish and support the skin barrier.

items.name: Organic Carrot Seed Oil
items.role: Beta-Carotene: A potent antioxidant that the body converts into retinol (Vitamin A), which is famous for supporting cell turnover and skin rejuvenation. Vitamin E: Especially tocopherols and tocotrienols, which help protect the skin from free radical damage. Essential Fatty Acids: Predominantly petroselinic acid (an Omega-12 fatty acid) and linoleic acid (Omega-6), which deeply moisturize and maintain the skin's natural barrier.

items.name: Siberian Sea Buckthorn Oil
items.role: Vitamins & Minerals: Extraordinary levels of Vitamin C, alongside Vitamin E, Vitamin K, and B-complex vitamins. Essential Fatty Acids: It is one of the few plant sources that contains the entire spectrum of Omegas: Omega-3, -6, -9, and the rare Omega-7, which is highly valued for cell regeneration. Antioxidants: Packed with flavonoids, quercetin, and carotenoids (such as beta-carotene). Amino Acids: Contains 18 amino acids, including essential ones the human body cannot produce itself.
